themes_detail.label: Illegal Parking Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal parking complaints spiked to 154 this week, a 40% increase over the 8-week average of 109.6 weekly complaints, suggesting a new enforcement or behavioral pattern emerging on Upper West Side streets.
evidence: 154 illegal parking complaints THIS WEEK vs. 109.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.84)
Illegal parking is second-highest complaint category overall (1,613 complaints over 90 days)
40% spike represents statistically significant deviation from baseline
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD or DOT about enforcement changes or new parking restrictions implemented recently
Survey residents and local business owners about parking availability and whether they've noticed new enforcement

themes_detail.label: Dead Trees in Parks
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints jumped to 5 this week, a 567% spike above the 8-week average of 0.8 weekly complaints, indicating possible disease, weather damage, or maintenance gap in Upper West Side green spaces.
evidence: 5 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.39, severity: high)
567% spike represents most extreme proportional increase among environment-related complaints
Coincides with recent unseasonable weather or pest activity patterns
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Parks about tree health assessments in Central Park and neighborhood parks; ask if disease or pest infestation detected
Photograph affected trees and speak with park users about visible decline in park conditions

themes_detail.label: Park Rules Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about park rule violations jumped to 4 this week, a 300% increase over the 8-week average of 1.0 weekly complaint, suggesting new enforcement gaps or user behavior changes in neighborhood parks.
evidence: 4 park rules violation complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.24, severity: high)
300% spike represents sharp departure from baseline
Timing aligns with warmer weather and increased park usage
reporting_angles: Visit Central Park and Riverside Park to observe what rule violations residents are reporting (alcohol, off-leash dogs, etc.)
Interview NYC Parks Enforcement about staffing levels and which violations are most common this week

themes_detail.label: Obstruction Complaints Rising
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints reached 10 last week, a 150% spike above the 8-week average of 4.0 weekly complaints, indicating blocked sidewalks, hydrants, or curbs affecting neighborhood accessibility.
evidence: 10 obstruction complaints last week vs. 4.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.37, severity: high)
150% increase represents sustained spike from baseline
May reflect seasonal construction, street furniture placement, or vendor encroachment
reporting_angles: Map locations of obstruction complaints to identify geographic cluster (specific blocks or intersections)
Interview DOT about street maintenance work or new construction projects approved recently

themes_detail.label: Day Care Facility Issues
themes_detail.summary: Day care complaints surged to 3 two weeks ago, a 700% spike above the 8-week average of 0.4 weekly complaints, suggesting potential licensing, safety, or operational concerns at a specific facility or facilities.
evidence: 3 day care complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.42, severity: high)
700% spike represents extreme deviation from baseline
Day care is highest-severity spike by z-score, indicating parents/community raising urgent concerns
reporting_angles: Request NYC Department of Health day care inspection reports for Upper West Side facilities filed in past 2 weeks
Interview parents about what specific concerns triggered complaints (safety, cleanliness, staffing, etc.)
Identify which facility(ies) are involved and check licensing history
